# braidworks serve

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cli_docs.py from `braidworks --help`; do not edit by hand.
     Run `make cli-docs` after changing the command line. -->

Open the browser interface to build and run queries. For the task this serves, see the [how-to guides](../../how-to/).

```text
usage: braidworks serve [-h] [--port PORT] [--host HOST] [--data-dir DIR] [--no-open]

Open the browser interface to build and run queries.

options:
  -h, --help      show this help message and exit
  --port PORT     port (default: 8765).
  --host HOST     bind host (default: localhost).
  --data-dir DIR  folder that browser-chosen cache/run files must live in (default: current dir).
  --no-open       do not open a browser.

examples:
  braidworks serve
  braidworks serve --port 8800 --no-open
```
